description: WALL-MEMBER-RENUMBER acceptance: b2-walls-v1.1-hole-stud-128 after B2's first edit, the door's offset 72 -> 48 (b2-walls-door-moved-24's walls at loft.wall 1.1.0). The Boolean still names stud/slot/8 and the hole is still in the stud at 128 along the front wall. Under 1.0.0 the same reference (stud/6) would name the end stud at 143.25, and the subtract would cut nothing: documents refuses that edit with a 409 instead.
derivation: Every expectation except the mesh counts is ANALYTIC, derived in services/geometry/tests/test_member_renumber.py (derived()) from the BASE golden's hand-derived expected.json and the cylinder's closed form, never from the kernel; that test asserts this file equals the derivation.
bore = 0.875 pi in^3, area change 3 pi in^2, centre (16, 1.75, 48) in, as b2-walls-v1.1-hole-stud-128.
volume = b2-walls-door-moved-24's 28488 in^3 - 0.875 pi in^3, x 25.4^3; centroid, mass (450 kg/m^3 SPF) and centre of mass re-weighted from b2-walls-door-moved-24's by the bore.
bounding_box: unchanged. topology: b2-walls-door-moved-24's + 1 face + 3 edges = 385, 771, 64.
MESH counts are the kernel's, recorded.
tolerance_rationale: Measured 2026-10-17: 1.2e-7 mm^3 on the volume, 7.5e-9 mm^2 on the area, <= 1.6e-12 mm on the centroid and centre of mass, 8.7e-11 g on the mass. 1e-6 is b2-walls-door-moved-24's bound, 8x the worst.
roundtrip_tolerance_rationale: Measured 2026-10-17: the STEP round trip moves the volume by 7.2e-7 mm^3, the area by 0 and the centroid by 1.6e-12 mm (the re-import's summation order, as the base golden). 3e-6 is the base golden's bound, 4.2x the worst; volume and area only.
